verdict.rationale: AgentMail's documented primitives give a team only a thin version of a shared inbox. Inboxes live under an organization, and threads can be listed org-wide. Labels are documented as a way to track conversation state, and an inbox can be opened in IMAP/SMTP clients such as Outlook or Apple Mail. Nothing describes a human team-collaboration layer, so shared conversation state for team members is only implied. Missing for 10: documented team or shared-inbox seats for multiple humans, shared views of read and assignment state, team channels or collaboration UI, and hands-on corroboration of team use.
